svg.title: Research direction: fault-tolerant flight now, adversarial robustness next, AI safety, security and policy ahead
svg.desc: Now: a learned policy that recovers from rotor faults the autopilot never notices. Next: robots that detect and survive spoofed sensors and attacks on learned policies. Ahead: carrying that evidence into technology policy.

g.text: Autonomous robots are leaving the lab faster than
we can say when they deserve our trust.
I want to help close that gap, with drones as my current testbed.
A learned policy that recovers from rotor
Robots that detect and survive spoofed
sensors and attacks on learned policies.
policy: safe by design, accountable in practice.
